desc: A legendary star apostle, tall humanoid with a pale skull face and glowing gold eyes, gold spiked crown, long deep navy cloak sprinkled with stars, holding a staff topped with a star. High quality 16-bit pixel art game pet, crisp pixels, right-facing 3/4 view, full body with empty margin, dark violet outline, pixel cluster shading with clear light and shadow, palette of lavender, pale violet, cream, ivory and deep navy, no background.
